public.title: Unique Paths
public.description: Count paths from the top-left to bottom-right cell of a rows by columns grid, moving only right or down. Both dimensions are integers from 1 through 15. The count fits a safe integer.
hints: Each cell receives paths from above and from its left.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: One row of counts suffices: update from left to right to combine the prior row and current left neighbor. O(rows times columns) time.
